caseNameFull: Ricebaum v. United States and Mendelson v. Same
attorneys: Messrs. A. Walton Nall and George F. Callaghan for petitioners in No. 861. Mr. John M. Slaton for petitioners in No. 871. Solicitor General Jackson, Assistant Attorney General McMahon, and Messrs. William W. Barron, J. Albert Woll, and' William J. Connor for the United States.

opinions.text:
Petitions for writs of certiorari to the Circuit Court of Appeals for the Fifth Circuit denied.

Mr. *629Justice Douglas took no part in the consideration and decision of these applications. Messrs. A. Walton Nall and George F. Callaghan for petitioners in No. 861. Mr. John M. Slaton for petitioners in No. 871. Solicitor General Jackson, Assistant Attorney General McMahon, and Messrs. William W. Barron, J. Albert Woll, and' William J. Connor for the United States.

Reported below: 101 F. 2d 628.
